ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (PerfectedStrike.cs:28-31) == cost 2 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Strike }` (PerfectedStrike.cs:19) == the tag set -- and here the tag is self-referential: the card counts Strike-tagged cards including itself, so getting the tag wrong would change its own damage by one step.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `CalculationBaseVar(6m)` + `ExtraDamageVar(2m)` + `CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).WithMultiplier(card => card.Owner.PlayerCombatState.AllCards.Count(c => c.Tags.Contains(CardTag.Strike)))` (PerfectedStrike.cs:21-26). `CalculatedVar.Calculate` is `base + extra * multiplier` (CalculatedVar.cs:62-71) == `self._base + self._extra * strikes`, and the multiplier scope matches: C#'s `AllCards` is every pile including Play, the sim's `all_cards` is every pile in declared order with Play last (player.py:184-188, re-cited from :100-103 -- decompiler/line-shift drift only, same semantics), and the card counts ITSELF on both sides because C# holds it in the Play pile while the sim parks the resolving card in the Play pile too via `_add_to_play_pile` inside `_resolve_card_play` (combat.py:1072, re-cited from :452-454 -- since round 13/R5 the sim's Play pile is real, not a discard-pile-limbo workaround; same de-hack noted at card/neows_fury and card/headbutt). Move without Unpowered -> powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.CalculatedDamage).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (PerfectedStrike.cs:36-39) == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, target, self.calc_damage(ctx, target), dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. Presentation, folded in: the two hit-VFX nodes and the CONDITIONAL heavy attacker animation, which C# selects when `CalculatedDamage.Calculate(target) > 12m` (PerfectedStrike.cs:40-43) -- a threshold that picks an ANIMATION only and has no state effect, so the sim needs no counterpart.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.ExtraDamage.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (PerfectedStrike.cs:49) == `self._extra += 1`, i.e. 6 + 3*strikes when upgraded. The BASE stays 6 on both sides -- same shape as card/ashen_strike and card/bully.
